The '''Dissection droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in the service of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Abominor]] known as the [[Great Heep]].

==Biography==
After warning [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] of the imminent danger if he were to remain in the [[Great Heep]]'s [[Droid harem]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was captured by the Heep and sent to be disassembled by a dissection droid. In the disassembly room, C-3PO was strapped to a table as the dissection droid prepared its instruments to dismantle the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]].

But before the droid could make the first cut, C-3PO was able to free one of his arms and press a lever to the side of the table. The table lifted the C-3PO to the ceiling, tilted to one side, and deposited him on a conveyor belt filled with metal scrap bound for the smelter.
